acceptanceCriteria: Hovering an architecture element on desktop produces a clearly visible scale or glow change distinguishable from the resting state
On a touch viewport (no pointer hover), interactive elements still communicate they are clickable without requiring a tap first
goal: Users on desktop clearly notice which 3D elements are interactive, and users on touch devices get an equivalent affordance without relying on hover
intent: Strengthen the WI-010 hover cue so it is actually perceptible, and add a touch-device discoverability cue since hover never fires on touch
outOfScope: no changes to the lifecycle or verification panels
